inventory.producer: scripts/smoke-tests/lib/utils.sh (scenario_state, file_mode) + run-all.sh (is_offline_safe) + runner-outcomes.sh (CI list integrity)
inputs: the new scenario file's own header: shebang, OFFLINE_SAFE=false line, lib/utils.sh sourcing, git-tracked mode
classes: present + executable + OFFLINE_SAFE=false declared (valid, this scenario)
missing / NOT_EXECUTABLE (invalid — not applicable, ruled out by direct inspection)
interactions: file mode x OFFLINE_SAFE declaration, both read by independent consumers (run-all.sh vs runner-outcomes.sh) and must agree

classes: fresh install, clean workspace, valid reachable HTTPS URL
interactions: install (AC-2) precedes update (AC-3) on the SAME cache slot/workspace

inventory.producer: same as AC-2 (update command shares resolveDatasetRoot/installFromSource)
inputs: --source <https-url>, workspace already installed from that URL
classes: update after a successful prior install from the same source
interactions: shares the install (AC-2) x update (AC-3) sequential interaction above

representations: stdout log lines emitted via @pair/content-ops logger
consumers: non-TTY capture of the install command's output ($TMP_DIR/last_cmd_output.log)
classes: downloadUrl containing 'github.com' -> 'KB not found, downloading vX from GitHub' (no ellipsis, no raw URL)
other URL -> '... from <url>...' (with ellipsis) — NOT exercised by the pinned happy-path URL, noted as an uncovered class
interactions: announceDownload emitted BEFORE the download; announceSuccess AFTER — both are asserted present in the same captured log

inventory.producer: packages/content-ops/src/path-resolution/source-detector.ts:isUnsupportedProtocol/detectSourceType, consumed at PARSE time by commands/install/parser.ts:resolveInstallSourceConfig and at RUNTIME by config/kb-resolver.ts:resolveLocalDataset
inputs: --source <value>: file://, ftp://, or a non-URL string
consumers: install command's synchronous parse-time throw ('Unsupported source protocol: ...') for file/ftp; the async resolveLocalDataset throw ('KB source path not found: ...') for a non-existent local-looking string
classes: non-URL non-existent path (falls through to LOCAL resolution, runtime throw)
interactions: protocol-check ordering: isUnsupportedProtocol is checked BEFORE isGitUrl/isRemoteUrl in detectSourceType

inputs: HTTP response status 404 from the download URL
representations: Error('Resource not found (404): <url>')  reformatted by apps/pair-cli/src/kb-manager/error-formatter.ts into 'KB v<version> not found (404). Download manually from: <origin>'
consumers: kb-installer.ts:installKB catch block -> CLI top-level error handler (cli.ts:main) -> process.exit(1)
classes: 404 (non-retryable — 'resource not found' does not match RETRYABLE_PATTERNS)
interactions: 404-detection x retry-eligibility: MUST fail on the FIRST attempt, no delay

inputs: ECONNREFUSED network error (nothing listening on the target host:port)
representations: Node https client socket error, wrapped by download-manager.ts:defaultErrorHandler.handleNetworkError -> 'Network error downloading KB: connect ECONNREFUSED ... . Check connectivity.'
consumers: kb-installer.ts:installKB catch block -> CLI top-level error handler -> process.exit(1)
interactions: retry-count x cumulative delay: 3 retries at [1s,2s,4s] = 7s LOWER BOUND before the final, permanent failure

representations: run-all.sh --offline-only discovery loop (full local-suite mode, independent of CI_TESTS/CI_EXCLUDED)
interactions: none beyond the single declaration read; NOT gated on the AC-9 CI_EXCLUDED registration

matrix.condition: pair install --source https://127.0.0.1:<port>/missing.zip against a local self-signed HTTPS server (SAN=IP:127.0.0.1) returning 404, trusted via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS scoped to this one command
matrix.rationale: Real run: exit 1 in 0s, 'Error: KB vunknown not found (404). Download manually from: https://127.0.0.1:<port>'. VERIFIED FINDING (contract-relevant, not a defect): the production HttpClientService (packages/content-ops/src/http/http-client-service.ts) calls Node's `https` module DIRECTLY and rejects a plain http:// URL SYNCHRONOUSLY ('Protocol "http:" not supported. Expected "https:"') before any network attempt — confirmed by direct execution. The card's Technical Analysis sketch of a plain `python3 -m http.server` (http://) fixture would therefore NEVER reach the 404/retry code paths; it would only ever hit this protocol guard. A local HTTPS server is required and is what this witness (and AC7-w1) actually uses. INJECTED-REGRESSION discriminance proof: added 'not found' to RETRYABLE_PATTERNS in the COMPILED packages/content-ops/dist/http/retryable-download.js (isolated to dist/) and re-ran the identical command: it then took 8s (retried the full budget) instead of failing fast, so the -le 3 assertion would now FAIL — discriminant. Reverted immediately (post-revert diff byte-identical). RE-VERIFIED under the corrected redTests[0].command: standalone re-run reproduced Test 5's PASS output exactly (Command failed as expected; 404 failed fast with no retry delay, 0s).

matrix.condition: pair install --source https://127.0.0.1:<closed-port>/kb.zip (nothing listening; OS-level ECONNREFUSED, no TLS handshake reached)
matrix.rationale: Real run: exit 1 in 7-8s across repeated executions, 'Error: Network error downloading KB: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:<port>. Check connectivity.'. INJECTED-REGRESSION discriminance proof: set DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES=0 in the COMPILED packages/content-ops/dist/http/retryable-download.js (isolated to dist/) and re-ran the identical command: it then failed in 0s, so the -ge 7 assertion would now FAIL — discriminant. Reverted immediately (post-revert diff byte-identical). Per-attempt retry logging is deliberately NOT asserted, per the card's Assumption 4 (downloadWithRetry retries silently by design). RE-VERIFIED under the corrected redTests[0].command: standalone re-run reproduced Test 6's PASS output exactly (Command failed as expected; connection-refused exhausted the retry budget, 7s >= 7s).
